status: Prototype: CAD checks passed; physical Rev E testing pending

schematic.visual_check: Schematic render inspected; blocks fit the page and labels are readable.
blocks: TX startup/undervoltage inhibit and bus sink
schematic.local_connections: Bridge, sense filter, hysteresis, power and TX connections are shown with wires. RX_REF and some bypass connections use matching labels.
schematic.netlist: U3 uses pin1=RX_REF and pin4=RX_ISO. Corrected physical pin/net relationships checked.
schematic.remaining_limits: No complete block-movement verification or full physical qualification.

layout_checks.notes: Both copper layers inspected. U3 has a continuous isolated ground plane beneath it. Ground domains remain separate. No exhaustive fast-edge return-path analysis.
Bypass capacitors are close to their ICs. Exact loop inductance and every manufacturer layout example have not been checked.
The sealed RECOM module contains the switching circuit. Its external input/output capacitors are nearby.
No worst-case temperature, load or enclosure thermal measurements.
The 0.5 mm branch to TP7 is a probe connection, not a series bottleneck in the main supply. Peak-current and temperature-rise margins have not been fully calculated.
The carrier has no high-speed differential route requiring impedance or length matching.
Module and enclosure RF performance, including the S3 Mini, need physical testing.
Front/back ground pours are stitched within their own domains. No visible bridge across the isolation gap; via placement has not been validated by EMC testing.
No exhaustive check of every via-to-pad intersection or assembler-specific process.
Nine test points cover supplies, grounds, RX, TX gate and rectified bus. Probe and module clearances still need checking on an assembled board.

automated_check_notes: Generic requests for 100 nF on VBUS_A, VBUS_B and VBUS_RECT were rejected: these carry bus signaling and are not ordinary supply rails.
The MAX809 has a push-pull reset output and an intentional pulldown; an open-drain reset pull-up is not required.
Module supply decoupling also depends on the fitted ESP module and needs testing with that module.

manufacturing_files.npth: Valid empty file; current holes are plated.

limitations: Rev E has not yet been manufactured or bench-tested.
No complete thermal, RF, EMC or safety-isolation qualification.
S3 Mini operation and enclosure fit are not physically verified.
No separate Gerber-viewer render or exhaustive solder-mask aperture comparison.
The optional RECOM STEP model is not included.
